sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Well, some call it the most dangerous place on the planet when it comes to facing a coronavirus outbreak.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在面对冠状病毒疫情爆发时，有人称这里是地球上最危险的地方。

sentences.en: A packed county jail could be a disaster waiting to happen.
sentences.zh: 挤满人的县监狱可能会是一场一触即发的灾难。

sentences.en: Across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 全美各地

sentences.en: The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department says...
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶县治安官办公室表示……

sentences.en: In Chicago, the Cook County Jail has...
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥，库克县监狱有……

sentences.en: Here, New York calls for quick action, now growing louder after...
sentences.zh: 在这里，纽约呼吁采取迅速行动，随着……的声音越来越大

sentences.en: Jails and prisons, with their cramped quarters and communal living, have become hotbeds for the spread of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 监狱由于空间狭窄和群居生活，已经成为了冠状病毒传播的温床。

sentences.en: Prisoners are sounding the alarm on the ballooning outbreak, writing messages on windows reading,
sentences.zh: 囚犯们对不断蔓延的疫情敲响了警钟，他们在窗户上写下信息，上面写着：

sentences.en: Help!
sentences.zh: 救命！

sentences.en: We matter and we're dying.
sentences.zh: 我们人命关天，我们在等死。

sentences.en: Everybody is losing their minds, not just the detainees, but also people that are working there.
sentences.zh: 所有人都快崩溃了，不仅仅是扣押人员，还包括在那里工作的人。

sentences.en: We cannot change the fundamental nature of jail.
sentences.zh: 我们无法改变监狱的根本性质。

sentences.en: We cannot socially distance dozens of elderly men living in a dorm, sharing a bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我们无法让住在宿舍里、共用浴室的几十名老年男性保持社交距离。

sentences.en: Think of a cruise ship recklessly boarding more passengers each day.
sentences.zh: 想想一艘邮轮每天不顾后果地接纳更多乘客。

sentences.en: Prompting local governments to take the unprecedented step of releasing thousands of inmates.
sentences.zh: 这促使地方政府采取了前所未有的措施，释放了数千名犯人。

sentences.en: People are confined to their homes, but this pandemic is actually bringing freedom to some New York City inmates.
sentences.zh: 人们被禁足在家，但这场大疫却实际上给一些纽约市的犯人带来了自由。

sentences.en: And raising the fraught question of who is let out and who remains in custody.
sentences.zh: 这也提出了一个令人揪心的问题：谁被释放，谁又继续被关押。

sentences.en: Today, Megan Toohey speaks with our colleague Alan Foyer about the story of one inmate trying to get out of the second largest jail in the country.
sentences.zh: 今天，梅根·图伊与我们的同事阿兰·福耶谈论了一个试图离开全国第二大监狱的犯人的故事。

sentences.en: Rikers Island in New York, April 23rd.
sentences.zh: 纽约赖克斯岛，4月23日。

sentences.en: So Alan, tell me about Mitch Pomerantz.
sentences.zh: 那么阿兰，跟我讲讲米奇·波梅兰茨的事吧。

sentences.en: So I met Mitch Pomerantz through his lawyer, Laura Arasso, and Mitch is 54.
sentences.zh: 我是通过他的律师劳拉·阿拉索认识米奇·波梅兰茨的，米奇今年54岁。

sentences.en: And before the virus even landed at Rikers, Mitch was already in bad health.
sentences.zh: 甚至在病毒登陆赖克斯岛之前，米奇的身体状况就已经很糟糕了。

sentences.en: In fact, his health was so bad at one point that he had to be transported off the island to a nearby hospital where he underwent surgery to drain fluid from his lungs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的健康状况一度糟糕到必须被转移出岛到附近的一家医院，并在那里接受了手术，以排出肺部积液。

sentences.en: And so he's been working with Laura's lawyer trying to build a case to get off of Rikers Island.
sentences.zh: 因此，他一直在与劳拉的律师合作，试图整理出一份离开赖克斯岛的案件材料。

sentences.en: And we recorded three of their conversations over the course of a week earlier this month.
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，我们在长达一周的时间里记录了他们之间的三次对话。

sentences.en: So, you know, like I had told you a little bit about earlier regarding today, we were in line all day for the Rikers to be heard.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，就像我之前跟你稍微提过关于今天的事一样，我们排了一整天的队等待赖克斯岛的听证。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, you know, the court only goes to 430 and they weren't able to squeeze it in on the calendar.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，你知道的，法院只开到四点半，他们没能在日程表里塞进这个案子。

sentences.en: The court system, don't forget, has more or less shut down because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，由于大流行，法院系统或多或少已经陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And on the day that we recorded our first call with Mitch, there wasn't indeed a backlog in the court system.
sentences.zh: 在我们与米奇录制第一通电话的那天，法院系统确实存在积压。

sentences.en: And the judge didn't have time to hear Mitch's case.
sentences.zh: 法官没有时间审理米奇的案子。

sentences.en: And while Mitch is waiting for the judge to hear his case, what is the situation like for him inside the jail?
sentences.zh: 在米奇等待法官审理他的案子期间，他在监狱里面的情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: I know your sister told me that somebody else in your dorm had been taken out.
sentences.zh: 我知道你姐姐告诉我，你宿舍里的另一个人被带走了。

sentences.en: So Mitch is housed in a dorm at Rikers, and that means that he lives with a dozen or so inmates in one open room.
sentences.zh: 所以米奇住在赖克斯岛的一个宿舍里，这意味着他和一个大通间里的十几个犯人住在一起。

sentences.en: And he tells his lawyer that one person in that dorm has tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他的律师，宿舍里有一个人的 COVID-19 检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: Mitch is also telling his lawyer here that the staff at Rikers hasn't cleaned the dorms since that person tested positive.
sentences.zh: 米奇还在这里告诉他的律师，自从那个人检测呈阳性以来，赖克斯岛的工作人员一直没有清洁宿舍。

sentences.en: So what did they, did they just test you and leave or did they do any, did they clean or sanitize or anything?
sentences.zh: 那他们，他们只是给你检测完就走了，还是做了什么，他们清洁或消毒了吗？

sentences.en: They didn't clean.
sentences.zh: 他们没有打扫。

sentences.en: They didn't even empty the garbage yet.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还没倒垃圾。

sentences.en: We have garbage overflowing, all the garbage pails, and they didn't, they didn't even clean.
sentences.zh: 我们的垃圾溢出来了，所有的垃圾桶都是，而且他们没有，他们甚至连打扫都没有。

sentences.en: They gave us a new test two days ago, three days ago.
sentences.zh: 他们两天前、三天前给我们做了新检测。

sentences.en: And he's the only one, the only one they told us about so far.
sentences.zh: 他是唯一的一个，目前他们告诉我们的只有这一个。

sentences.en: And, you know, so I'm sure I'm positive as far.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，所以我确信我的结果肯定也是阳性。

sentences.en: I'm praying it's not me.
sentences.zh: 我祈祷那不是我。

sentences.en: I mean, was he wearing a mask or anything?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他戴口罩了吗？

sentences.en: No, never.
sentences.zh: 没有，从来没有。

sentences.en: They gave us one mask for the whole week yesterday, last night.
sentences.zh: 昨天，也就是昨晚，他们给我们每人发了一个口罩管一整周。

sentences.en: My mask fell apart like four days ago.
sentences.zh: 我的口罩在大约四天前就散架了。

sentences.en: So I had no mask.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有口罩。

sentences.en: I've had no mask for four days.
sentences.zh: 我已经四天没有口罩了。

sentences.en: And how does that description of the conditions, at least in his particular dorm, how does that square with what you've learned in your reporting?
sentences.zh: 这种对环境的描述，至少在他那个特定的宿舍里，这与你在报道中了解到的情况有何出入？

sentences.en: Well, from the start of the crisis, the Department of Corrections has taken several measures to slow the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从危机开始以来，惩教局已经采取了几项措施来减缓病毒的传播。

sentences.en: They've asked inmates to sleep head to toe at night.
sentences.zh: 他们要求犯人在晚上睡觉时头脚交错。

sentences.en: You know, they wanted to get one mouth and nose as far away from another mouth and nose as they could.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们希望把一个人的嘴和鼻子尽可能地远离另一个人的嘴和鼻子。

sentences.en: They had the cleaning staff, clean the common areas and the housing areas as best as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们让清洁人员尽最大努力清洁公共区域和居住区域。

sentences.en: But the fact is, conditions at Rikers remain very unsanitary.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，赖克斯岛的条件仍然极其不卫生。

sentences.en: You know, inmates can't get hand sanitizer because it's an alcohol-based product and they're not allowed to have alcohol.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，犯人们拿不到免洗手消毒液，因为它是含酒精的产品，而他们不允许接触酒精。

sentences.en: Oftentimes, the only way for them to get soap for their own personal hygiene is to buy it in the commissary.
sentences.zh: 通常，他们为个人卫生获取肥皂的唯一方法就是在小卖部购买。

sentences.en: So these measures that were put in place to stop the spread of the virus haven't always worked.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些旨在阻止病毒传播的措施并没有总是奏效。

sentences.en: I mean, how close?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有多近？

sentences.en: I know you guys sleep like in pretty close proximity.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们睡觉的距离其实很近。

sentences.en: How close do you think you were to him?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你离他有多近？

sentences.en: About five feet, six feet from me.
sentences.zh: 离我大约五英尺、六英尺吧。

sentences.en: He sleeps, he slept over, over the next aisle, over one person over.
sentences.zh: 他睡在，他睡在隔壁过道，隔了一个人。

sentences.en: So that's best for me, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说最好是这样，对。

sentences.en: But how do you feel?
sentences.zh: 但是你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Like, how do your lungs feel?
sentences.zh: 比如，你的肺感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I know, you know, you're going through it too.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你知道的，你也在经历这一切。

sentences.en: Where they operate in Israel, it hurts a lot.
sentences.zh: 他们做手术的地方，真的很痛。

sentences.en: So it sounds like Mitch's risk of getting COVID-19 is really high.
sentences.zh: 听起来米奇感染 COVID-19 的风险非常高。

sentences.en: Yes, but in fact, Mitch's lawyer, Laura, expects they could get a decision from the judge very soon about the question of his release.
sentences.zh: 是的，但事实上，米奇的律师劳拉预计他们很快就能从法官那里得到关于他获释问题的决定。

sentences.en: And hopefully we get a result tomorrow, but we can talk more about that, okay?
sentences.zh: 希望我们明天能得到结果，但我们可以多聊聊这个，好吗？

sentences.en: Okay, thank you so much for everything.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你所做的一切。

sentences.en: I appreciate the help.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你的帮助。

sentences.en: I'll be talking to you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天再跟你通话。

sentences.en: All right, stay well.
sentences.zh: 好的，保重。

sentences.en: Okay, bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 好的，再见。

sentences.en: Good luck, thank you.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，谢谢。

sentences.en: But when they talk the next day...
sentences.zh: 但当他们第二天交谈时……

sentences.en: Hey, can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 喂，你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 听得到。

sentences.en: She's got some bad news.
sentences.zh: 她带回了一些坏消息。

sentences.en: She and her team went in front of the judge.
sentences.zh: 她和她的团队出庭面见了法官。

sentences.en: They argued the case.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了辩论。

sentences.en: And the judge has said, no.
sentences.zh: 而法官说，不行。

sentences.en: Mitch can't get out.
sentences.zh: 米奇不能出去。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: ...do it as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: ……尽快完成。

sentences.en: I realized that someone else who was sleeping next to you had tested positive.
sentences.zh: 我意识到另一个睡在你旁边的人检测呈阳性了。

sentences.en: Someone else.
sentences.zh: 另一个人。

sentences.en: Not someone else.
sentences.zh: 不只是另一个人。

sentences.en: Four people.
sentences.zh: 四个人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So they came back today with the test?
sentences.zh: 所以他们今天带着检测结果回来了？

sentences.en: Four people.
sentences.zh: 四个人。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: This is crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This is absolutely crazy.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是疯了。

sentences.en: They're killing us.
sentences.zh: 他们在杀死我们。

sentences.en: They are killing us.
sentences.zh: 他们在杀死我们。

sentences.en: What are we supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: What do we do?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么做？

sentences.en: We need to file a writ.
sentences.zh: 我们需要申请令人安身的人身保护令。

sentences.en: I need to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我需要离开这里。

sentences.en: I need to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我需要离开这里。

sentences.en: They're killing me.
sentences.zh: 他们是在害死我。

sentences.en: If I catch this, I'm dead.
sentences.zh: 如果我染上这个，我就死定了。

sentences.en: I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: We need somebody to step in.
sentences.zh: 我们需要有人介入。

sentences.en: We need somebody that's important to step in.
sentences.zh: 我们需要有影响力的人介入。

sentences.en: A congressman, a senator, somebody.
sentences.zh: 国会议员，参议员，随便什么人。

sentences.en: A court, a judge.
sentences.zh: 法庭，法官。

sentences.en: Somebody's got to do something for us.
sentences.zh: 总得有人为我们做点什么。

sentences.en: Somebody.
sentences.zh: 总得有人。

sentences.en: So by this point, Rikers has already released hundreds of inmates.
sentences.zh: 所以到这个时候，赖克斯岛已经释放了数百名犯人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So how are they deciding who stays and who goes?
sentences.zh: 那么他们是如何决定谁留谁走的呢？

sentences.en: Well, so far, they've released 650 people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止，他们已经释放了650人。

sentences.en: And of those 650 people, you're generally talking about three different categories of inmates.
sentences.zh: 在这650人中，你通常讨论的是三种不同类别的犯人。

sentences.en: First, there are those who have been accused of nonviolent low-level offenses.
sentences.zh: 首先，是被指控犯有非暴力低级别罪行的人。

sentences.en: There are also people who are at Rikers serving what's called a city year, a sentence that is short, less than a year.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人在赖克斯岛服刑，也就是所谓的“城市年”，刑期很短，不到一年。

sentences.en: And so they're about to get out anyhow.
sentences.zh: 所以他们无论如何都快要出狱了。

sentences.en: And then there's a third category of people who are at the island because they've committed
sentences.zh: 然后还有第三类人，他们在这个岛上是因为他们犯了

sentences.en: a technical violation of their parole, meaning they were out on parole for a previous crime
sentences.zh: 他们假释的技术性违规，这意味着他们因之前的犯罪而在外假释

sentences.en: and they got caught doing something minor like smoking a joint or drinking a beer on their sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 他们被抓到做了一些小事，比如在人行道上抽大麻烟或者喝啤酒。

sentences.en: So how does Mitch fit into this picture?
sentences.zh: 那么米奇是怎么切入这个画面的呢？

sentences.en: So the challenge for Mitch is that his case is just a lot more complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以对米奇来说，挑战在于他的案子要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Mitch has served a combined 22 years in prison for selling drugs and committing multiple robberies.
sentences.zh: 米奇因贩毒和多次抢劫在监狱里服刑了总共22年。

sentences.en: The state considers him a violent offender.
sentences.zh: 州政府认为他是暴力罪犯。

sentences.en: He got out of prison in 2018.
sentences.zh: 他在2018年出狱。

sentences.en: But then last summer, he was rearrested for an attempted robbery charge while he was on parole.
sentences.zh: 但去年夏天，他在假释期间因涉嫌企图抢劫再次被捕。

sentences.en: So Mitch just doesn't really fit neatly into any of those categories for people that were getting off Rikers Island.
sentences.zh: 所以米奇并不真的完全符合离开赖克斯岛人员的任何一类。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And yet he's medically vulnerable, which is another factor that judges are weighing in releasing people from Rikers and that the city itself is prioritizing people like that.
sentences.zh: 然而他的身体状况很脆弱，这是法官在释放赖克斯岛人员时权衡的另一个因素，而且城市本身也在优先考虑这样的人。

sentences.en: Those people who, if they catch COVID-19, they're more likely to die.
sentences.zh: 那些人，如果他们感染了 COVID-19，他们更有可能死亡。

sentences.en: We're trying to put as much pressure on the governor, on New York State docks, on Commissioner
sentences.zh: 我们正试图向州长、纽约州惩教署、专员

sentences.en: Anucci, to release everyone and release them safely.
sentences.zh: 阿努奇施加尽可能大的压力，释放所有人并安全地释放他们。

sentences.en: I mean, as I said before...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像我之前说的……

sentences.en: I don't care about everyone.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎所有人。

sentences.en: I want to get out.
sentences.zh: 我想出去。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get myself out.
sentences.zh: 我在想方设法弄出去。

sentences.en: I don't care about anybody else.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎别人。

sentences.en: Everyone else is not sick like I am.
sentences.zh: 其他人没有像我一样生病。

sentences.en: I'm going to die if I have this.
sentences.zh: 如果得了这个我会死的。

sentences.en: If I get it, I'm going to die.
